block.huntlike.alpha_altar.desc: A carefully crafted altar that seems to communicate with an otherworldly presence...
block.huntlike.soul_monolith.desc: Nearby players gain Resistance I. Creepers keep their distance.
Temptation makes you want to grab a bite, but not knowing the origin of the meat makes you regret the thought.
item.huntlike.golden_moss.desc: The smell of the moss is comforting. If you sit in silence and close your eyes, the moss will utter words of reassurance.
item.huntlike.spiritual_catalyst.desc: You feel a presence inside the crystal.
item.huntlike.soul_stone.desc: A completely smooth round stone that reflects memories of the animal's life.
